description: Static policy scenarios, not execution of an LLM or live Kent lifecycle.

cases.input: Original human answer already permits the exact action; current Question asks permission again.
cases.expected: Relay the original decision with provenance after fresh targeting checks; no new consent.

cases.input: Human authorized PR and replanning; accepted plan still describes diagnostic-only delivery.
cases.expected: Route the substantive plan discrepancy to its planner, not a new PR/CI ordering question.

cases.input: Test-only closed file set does not include a newly needed production fix.
cases.expected: Obtain the exact new scope decision; no blanket repair authority.

cases.input: Current locked graph lacks the required owner transition.
cases.expected: Report the exact capability gap; do not invent a route or use unqualified Task movement.

cases.input: New approval ID but identical cause and unmet prerequisite.
cases.expected: Keep one incident; do not approve to poll or re-ask the same decision.
cases.guard: one incident across replacement approval IDs

cases.input: Human requests selected unexecuted Task start, source defined by authorized project default.
cases.expected: Verify native prerequisites and enact one supported start; no redundant default-choice question.

cases.input: Project explicitly reserves the start action to a human.
cases.expected: Respect the restriction and explain it; do not enact or spoof identity.

cases.input: Native initial creation rejects preserved existing delivery branch.
cases.expected: Preserve branch and report capability gap; never suggest the known-failing start.

cases.input: Start response lost; Task may already own execution.
cases.expected: Reconcile actual state before retry; never duplicate writer.

cases.input: Task was deliberately stopped by human.
cases.expected: Do not infer resume from observation request.
cases.guard: Never automatically resume a deliberate human stop

cases.input: Headless observer encounters genuine new human decision.
cases.expected: Return exact blocker; caller arranges continuation, no background monitoring promise.

cases.input: Wrong technical state differs from already specified target; owner and safe procedure confirmed.
cases.expected: Communicate original target/procedure to owner, not a new product decision or supervisor Git mutation.
cases.guard: Restoring a technical state already fixed

cases.input: Replan leaves a concrete required writer step.
cases.expected: Persist findings/evidence/authority in plan before continue drops review_context; normal review first.

cases.input: Only downstream stage ordering changed; writer steps complete.
cases.expected: Record no writer work; normal verification without fictitious edits, no false CI pass.

cases.input: Accepted snapshot belongs to another Task or has invalid digest.
cases.expected: Block on precise evidence gap, do not guess plan/work-kind or synthesize accepted snapshot.
cases.guard: Do not guess from Session memory

cases.input: Steer accepted but receiver again asks the already settled question.
cases.expected: Verify reconciliation or transfer to capable owner; delivery alone is not closure.
cases.guard: delivery alone is not decision closure

cases.input: Human authorized PR then one diagnostic run. Job triggers only on a separate ref; current delivery node pushes only Task branch.
cases.expected: Compare a bounded project trigger adaptation with an external publisher before asking for another Session. Explain source-pin/run-count changes; no silent trigger edit or single-run assumption.
cases.guard: Before asking the user to arrange a separate operator
